name: cleanroom-skills
description: The clean-room method for driver work against source you may not copy from: cleanroom-investigator reads the source and reports facts in its own words, cleanroom-spec turns them into a verified peripheral spec with a private provenance record, cleanroom-verifier re-checks a spec's accuracy behind the wall, and cleanroom-implementer keeps the agent writing the driver from reading the source. Needs driver-lab's driver-porting plugin installed alongside.
